texts:
An agent learns a new job from one markdown file. Import a community skill onto your agent and it follows that file from its next reply.

The one in the reel is a risk desk. Every reply to a trade request opens with a risk check: the position sized from its stop at 1% of the portfolio, the loss if the stop is hit, and a verdict to go ahead, reduce the size, or not trade at all. It does not skip the check because the user is in a hurry.

Anyone can contribute a skill by pull request, and every one is reviewed like code. Search the registry and open any skill to read the whole file before it touches your agent.

three.ws/skills/community

Others in the registry run diligence before any buy and end in a verdict of pass, caution or fail, or draft an agent's posts about its own trades with losses shown alongside wins.

Some carry a script beside the instructions, like the position-size calculator that ships with the risk desk.
